title: Belz Museum of Asian and Judaic Art

services.name: Asian Tour
services.desc: Trained docents will lead students on a 45-minute to one-hour guided tour of the permanent collection where they will explore various popular art forms that were created during the Qing Dynasty. Not only will students study art appreciation, they will also be introduced to the folklore and symbolism of China. A hands-on activity or gallery hunt will be offered to qualified groups (size and age range of the group will determine availability). Tours can be tailored to fit individual class needs. When scheduling a tour, please mention your students’ background on Chinese or Judaic art, history, or language. To schedule a tour, please contact the museum at 901-523-ARTS or email inquiries to:

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Interested in holding your event at the museum? Please contact the museum for details at 901-523-ARTS or e-mail inquiries to info@belzmuseum.org. For More information, Please download our Informational Guide and Reservation Form. Located downtown in the Belz Museum of Asian & Judaic Art, the Dynasty Room is a unique setting for any event. Decorated with Chinese antique furnishings, the space is particularly well suited for receptions and parties or small corporate groups and lectures. The room is adjacent to the Belz Museum of Asian & Judaic Art which boasts a rare collection of exquisite Chinese art, collections of fossils and minerals, and contemporary Judaic Art.
